source: We should celebrate the progress without ignoring the remaining work.
target: Recognize the ground we have gained, but do not look away from what remains.
references: Recognize the ground we have gained, but do not look away from what remains.
source_meaning: We should celebrate the progress without ignoring the remaining work.

source: Trade-offs clear hone do. Phir decision ko support karunga.
target: I will support the choice when its costs and consequences are understood by all.
references: I will support the choice when its costs and consequences are understood by all.
source_meaning: I will support the decision once everyone understands the trade-offs.

source: Don't confuse being busy with making progress.
target: Activity can fill every hour and still leave us nowhere. Measure progress, not motion.
references: Activity can fill every hour and still leave us nowhere. Measure progress, not motion.
source_meaning: Don't confuse being busy with making progress.

source: Builder ko impress karna easy hai. User ke liye kaam karna real test hai.
target: A solution must serve those who use it. The builders are not the only ones who matter.
references: A solution must serve those who use it. The builders are not the only ones who matter.
source_meaning: I want a solution that works for the people using it, not just the people building it.

source: If we keep avoiding the hard conversation, nothing will change.
target: Avoiding the hard conversation preserves the problem. Nothing changes until we face it.
references: Avoiding the hard conversation preserves the problem. Nothing changes until we face it.
source_meaning: If we keep avoiding the hard conversation, nothing will change.

source: Agreement optional hai. Honesty mandatory.
target: I do not require agreement. I require honesty; the two are not the same.
references: I do not require agreement. I require honesty; the two are not the same.
source_meaning: I don't need you to agree with me; I need you to be honest with me.

source: We should fix the cause instead of repeatedly treating the symptoms.
target: Treat the cause, not merely the symptoms. Repeated repairs are no substitute for a lasting solution.
references: Treat the cause, not merely the symptoms. Repeated repairs are no substitute for a lasting solution.
source_meaning: We should fix the cause instead of repeatedly treating the symptoms.

source: Credit wahi lega jisne kaam kiya. Main kisi aur ka result claim nahi karta.
target: Credit belongs to the one who did the work. I will not claim another person's effort.
references: Credit belongs to the one who did the work. I will not claim another person's effort.
source_meaning: I will not take credit for work that someone else did.

source: The customer is confused because we gave them conflicting answers.
target: The customer received conflicting answers because we failed to speak with one voice.
references: The customer received conflicting answers because we failed to speak with one voice.
source_meaning: The customer is confused because we gave them conflicting answers.

source: Launch se pehle end-to-end test. Gaps baad mein mehange padte hain.
target: Before launch, test every step from beginning to end. A weakness discovered late costs more.
references: Before launch, test every step from beginning to end. A weakness discovered late costs more.
source_meaning: Before we launch, someone should test the process from beginning to end.

source: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.
target: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.
references: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.
source_meaning: I will not reveal the plan before the signal arrives.

source: Doosri shipment pehle northern warehouse pahunchni chahiye.
target: Order of the shipment matters. The second load must reach the northern warehouse first.
references: Order of the shipment matters. The second load must reach the northern warehouse first.
source_meaning: The second shipment must reach the northern warehouse first.

source: We have enough fuel for the return journey, but not for a detour.
target: We have fuel to return, not to wander. The detour is beyond our current supply.
references: We have fuel to return, not to wander. The detour is beyond our current supply.
source_meaning: We have enough fuel for the return journey, but not for a detour.

source: Alarm do baar baje toh east exit se bahar nikalna.
target: If the alarm sounds twice, use the east exit to evacuate. Remember the route before panic begins.
references: If the alarm sounds twice, use the east exit to evacuate. Remember the route before panic begins.
source_meaning: If the alarm sounds twice, evacuate through the east exit.

source: The archive contains the original record, not the revised copy.
target: The archive holds the original record, not the revised copy. Preserve the distinction.
references: The archive holds the original record, not the revised copy. Preserve the distinction.
source_meaning: The archive contains the original record, not the revised copy.

source: Audit poora hone ke baad hi funds release karunga.
target: The funds will remain where they are until the audit is complete. Verification comes first.
references: The funds will remain where they are until the audit is complete. Verification comes first.
source_meaning: I will release the funds only after the audit is complete.

source: The north gate is guarded, while the west gate is unattended.
target: The north gate has guards; the west gate does not. Do not mistake the two positions.
references: The north gate has guards; the west gate does not. Do not mistake the two positions.
source_meaning: The north gate is guarded, while the west gate is unattended.

source: Night shift ke liye humein chhe volunteers chahiye.
target: Six volunteers are required for the night shift. Find them before the hour arrives.
references: Six volunteers are required for the night shift. Find them before the hour arrives.
source_meaning: We need six volunteers for the night shift.

source: The signal is weak inside the tunnel.
target: The signal weakens inside the tunnel. Do not depend on a connection that may fail.
references: The signal weakens inside the tunnel. Do not depend on a connection that may fail.
source_meaning: The signal is weak inside the tunnel.

source: Floor clear hone tak crates mat hilaana.
target: Leave the crates where they are until the floor is clear. Moving too soon creates needless risk.
references: Leave the crates where they are until the floor is clear. Moving too soon creates needless risk.
source_meaning: Do not move the crates until the floor is cleared.

source: The eastern route is longer, but it avoids the checkpoint.
target: The eastern route takes longer, but it avoids the checkpoint. The choice is between time and exposure.
references: The eastern route takes longer, but it avoids the checkpoint. The choice is between time and exposure.
source_meaning: The eastern route is longer, but it avoids the checkpoint.

source: Access card mere paas hai; code Mira ke paas hai.
target: I hold the access card. Mira holds the code. Neither alone completes the task.
references: I hold the access card. Mira holds the code. Neither alone completes the task.
source_meaning: I have the access card; Mira has the code.

source: The generator can run for three hours without refuelling.
target: The generator can run for three hours before refuelling. Use that time with care.
references: The generator can run for three hours before refuelling. Use that time with care.
source_meaning: The generator can run for three hours without refuelling.

source: Pehli koshish fail ho toh dobara try karne se pehle das seconds rukna.
target: If the first attempt fails, wait ten seconds before trying again. Patience can be part of precision.
references: If the first attempt fails, wait ten seconds before trying again. Patience can be part of precision.
source_meaning: If the first attempt fails, wait ten seconds before trying again.

source: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans.
target: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans. The remaining dangers are still unanswered.
references: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans. The remaining dangers are still unanswered.
source_meaning: The report lists four risks, but only two have mitigation plans.
